entities.name: Independence and Siege of Vukovar
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Independence and Siege of Vukovar, a transformative movement in Croatia (1991–1992). Emerged from Fall of Vukovar after 87-day siege; Ovčara massacre and Croatia declares independence from Yugoslavia. Catalyzed Operation Storm and Reintegration.
